title: Creator Workspace, Renderer-Neutral Projection, Draft/Rebase & Authority Contract
objective: Establish the character/creature creator workspace over renderer-neutral appearance projections with explicit draft, preview, owner-bound and rebase/version dispositions while preserving Character, NPC, Creature, Species/Form, Inventory/Asset, relationship, CAPP/PPIA/PAPT and ARI authority.

scope.purpose: Create the bounded MCCS creator workspace and authority/disposition seam without becoming canonical character, creature, anatomy, equipment, relationship or runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: A versioned creator workspace can create, inspect, preview and rebase renderer-neutral appearance drafts/projections against governed owner records with explicit disposition/provenance and no silent canonical mutation.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01 completed the reduced MCCS creator-workspace foundation with renderer-neutral appearance projection, explicit draft/preview/owner-bound disposition, stale-version detection and explicit refresh/rebase planning.

Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owner domains, CAPP/PPIA renderer-neutral appearance authority, PAPT/PCA production primitives and ARI resource/provenance/rights authority remained external and authoritative; MCCS-01 created no canonical owner mutation or renderer-specific identity.
Topology remained nonhumanoid-first: unsupported or unresolved anatomy stays explicit rather than being fabricated into compatibility.

Application PR 575 passed exact-head selector/health, Linux, Windows and deterministic cross-platform validation on head bb7119193213b22876e789fb58b0e1e24b654259 against base a42fb6e4ba48b02b2ef6b5c02237da7e0f30bca6 in run 35344718903.

Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 reconciliation confirms the MNCS rotation start requirements: MCCS-01 is now completed_verified, MIB-09 is completed_verified, DPL is completed_verified, and PPIA-02/NPC-Creature owner contracts are available. MCCS-03 remains the next surviving MCCS-local tranche, but the DAG-authorized MNCS-01 rotation takes the live product-development selection now; MCCS-21 remains an MNCS golden-proof dependency rather than an MNCS-01 start requirement.
The independent ui-implementation lane is preserved unchanged.
